questions.q: What is produced on Friday from the sales@ mailbox?
o: A weekly mail digest document filed in the Weekly Summaries folder
A bulk update to every opportunity
A pipeline sweep of the reps' spreadsheets
questions.e: The Friday weekly mail digest summarises orders received, supplier orders and deliveries into a document. It is read-only - it never writes to the CRM. The audit is Monday's and the sweep is Tuesday's.

questions.q: What happens to the actions agreed at the weekly sales meeting?
o: They stay in the minutes document
They become Tasks in the CRM and appear in the Sales Pulse
They are emailed round as a list
questions.e: The minutes are ingested into the CRM as Tasks grouped by owner, and they render in the Sales Pulse with Done, Carry and Answer buttons.

questions.q: What is the target for the first meaningful response on a case?
questions.e: Acknowledgement within 1 working hour, first meaningful response within 4 working hours. Both are measured from the case timestamps, which are stamped automatically.

questions.q: You take a phone call that could turn into an order. When should the opportunity be created?
o: Once a formal quote has been issued
Only if the value is above a threshold
questions.e: Same day, even as a one-liner. If it is not in the CRM it does not exist at the review - and a rough amount can be refined later.
